title: Census event v1
description: One line of units/<id>/census.jsonl (CENSO-NO-MANIFESTO; D-063, D-064 a, D-067): one event of the unit's append-only literal census. The live census of a unit is the fold of its events in order. scripts/census is the only writer. scripts/census check, run by structure-check, refuses a line that is not this shape, a file that is not the writer's canonical rendering, a broken digest chain, a history whose events at the base are not a prefix of its events now, and a live path that resolves to no unit, to two units or to another unit. It replaces the per-area files scripts/lib/literal-catalogs/<area>.json and scripts/lib/absolute-literals-baseline/<area>.json (the unversioned shapes `{description, catalogs}` and `{description, files}`), which scripts/generate census now derives on demand.

n.description: The event's position in the record, from 1, with no gaps.

at.description: The UTC date the writer recorded the event.

by.description: Who ran the writer: --actor, else git user.email, else $USER.

op.description: add: the path is new to this census of the unit. set: it replaces the live entry. remove: the live entry goes.

census.description: catalog: a D-063 literal catalog, a file whose literals are the documented keys of a domain. baseline: an absolute-census exception, a file whose remaining offenders are still allowed (D-063, D-064 a).

path.description: The repository path the entry is about. It must belong to this record's unit and to no other (units.units_of).

entry.description: The live entry after an add or a set; absent on a remove.

why.description: The reason the writer was given (--why).

prev.description: The digest of the event before, or census.genesis_digest for the first.

digest.description: census.digest_algorithm of the event without this field (scripts/lib/audit_chain.py).

domains.description: The D-050 and D-063 domains whose values the file holds.

holds.description: One sentence on what the file holds.

generatedFrom.description: The source a generator writes the file from; its keys are documented there.

builders.description: A schema catalog's builder modules (import specifiers): it may call what it imports from them and pass them expression callbacks, and nothing else.

baseline.description: Per `<kind> <value as JSON>`, how many times the file may still spell it. Read from the absolute scan, never typed.
